messages:
emma: Kicking off deploy for release v2.3.1 — enabling feature_gate=llm-route-v4 with an incremental ramp 5% -> 25% -> 75% -> 100% over 2h windows. Deploybot scheduled at 12:15 UTC. Release notes: https://rlwd/rel-notes/v2.3.1 :rocket:
raj: Thanks — what's the safety checklist? thresholds, canary cohort, and pin strategy?
emma: Canary on EU/eu-west and NA/west pools. Safety gates: >5% relative error rate increase OR +15% P95 latency -> hold and investigate. If hold persists >15m -> rollback to pinned version v2.3.0 and disable flag.
oliver: Add quality gate too — if chat hallucination score (prompt-set-smoketest) drops by 2pt -> hold. Who's owning the smoke eval?
emma: oliver owns smoke eval. I'll pin routing config and model version on the infra side — pin key: model-route:v2.3.0 until long-run is stable.
deploy-bot: deploybot: Starting canary: enabling llm-route-v4 for cohort id=canary-42 (5%). Logs: ```deploy start 2026-03-23T12:15:00Z cohort canary-42 -> 5%```
oliver: smoke eval running now. baseline metrics loaded.
sre-oncall: Watching SLOs and infra traces. Alert windows set: latency_p95_delta > 12% and error_rate_abs > 0.5% triggers paging.
raj: Quick note — autoscale policy bumped for canary pool to avoid flapping. Metric dashboards: https://grafana/rlwd/d/llmroute
deploy-bot: deploybot: Canary rollout to 25% complete at 12:32 UTC. No hard errors flagged.
ometer-bot: (metric-kv) p95 latency +3% in na-west, error_rate +0.1%
oliver: Smoke eval quality down 1.8pt — still under threshold but worth monitoring.
emma: Proceed to 75% after 20m if metrics hold. I'll be on pager.
sre-oncall: Noted. Setting temporary higher sampling for traces.
deploy-bot: deploybot: Rolling to 75% at 12:55 UTC.
ometer-bot: p95 latency +11% in eu-west; error_rate +0.6% in eu-west (origin: model-inference timeouts).
raj: eu-west looks noisy. Can we narrow to backend shard? tagging traces now.
oliver: smoke eval failed on 4/20 prompts — hallucination drift >2pt in eu-west.
emma: Holding rollout. Initiating rollback checklist. First step: freeze flag at current cohorts, prevent further increases.
deploy-bot: deploybot: Rollback initiated by @emma — disabling llm-route-v4 in eu-west cohorts, draining to v2.3.0. Rolling back routing config and unpin requests to safe version.
sre-oncall: Performing canary rollback. Kicking off puppet change to pin model-route:v2.3.0 across affected pools.
raj: Will notify product/CS about partial rollback and potential small service blip. Drafting quick release note update.
oliver: Running full smoke eval on the rolled back state to validate recovery.
emma: Postmortem note: suspect quantization mismatch in the v4 variant under longer seq lengths in eu-west. We'll open an RFC for model-variant validation.
deploy-bot: deploybot: Rollback complete at 13:02 UTC. All cohorts back to v2.3.0.
sre-oncall: Confirmed SLOs recovered to baseline within 6 minutes. No triggered pages.
raj: Thanks all. Follow-ups: 1) hold re-roll until model fix + extra A/B tests, 2) update release notes, 3) schedule a postmortem session at 16:00 UTC.
emma: Agreed. I'll file the incident ticket and add notes to the changelog. :white_check_mark:
